verdict.rationale: Jeeves docs claim stablecoin-powered cross-border payments settling in minutes (vs 24-48h SWIFT), with 24/7 availability, mid-market rates, and instant FX conversion, directly matching the founder's story of fast international money transfer. Multiple docs pages corroborate this via Jeeves Instant Pay / Global Payments and Jeeves Cash features. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of actual transfer speed and no third-party corroboration beyond first-party docs.
